retained_sdk_consistency.reason: Every actual native FP32 and source Q8 digest equals the old saved outputs on identical source/model/reference bytes. The following values are retained from the previous report, not newly measured ground truth.

scope: Standalone V2 same-code stereo module; API wall excludes input read/SHA, output hashes, disk saves and report generation; not complete V2 DAG or online frame throughput. BPU submit/wait includes submission/queue/wait, not pure device cycles.
optimization_boundaries: F32 unquantized single-channel dense-width output uses validated row copy plus the original exceptional float conversions for NaN/subnormal. Other tensor contracts retain the generic decoder.

Equal-size Q8 normalization skips double numerator/weight/valid maps and same-size resizes; crop reuses the exact row kernel and leaves outside ROI zero. Actual geometry resize retains the previous implementation.

ARM NEON rounding uses integer part and an exact half-integer comparison; it does not use rounded float addition of 0.5. Q8 remains floor(double(d)*256+0.5), 1..65535 only, invalid/underflow/overflow zero.
